description: A React functional component implementing a user search modal with search by email or user ID, utilizing Ant Design UI components, local state management, and debounce for optimizing search input handling.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Fetches user data based on search text and field (email or ID) with debouncing to prevent excessive calls.

methods.name: debouncedSearch
methods.description: Debounced version of the fetchUsers function to optimize search calls.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input change, sets the current search field, and triggers debounced fetch.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection from search options, updating form fields accordingly.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form fields and user options, then triggers modal close via onCancel.
